sources.label: Alto DUSD mint and borrow documentation

reserveReview.rationale: Alto documents that only mint markets create DUSD; borrow markets redistribute lender-supplied DUSD and are not backing sources. The 2026-07-21 issuer API reports active mint-market DUSD debt of 32,735.51647 against sUSDe, 3,903.60575 against WETH, 885.53777 against syrupUSDC, 633.58275 against rETH, and 49,500.86509 against wstETH. Combining those debts with the USM's 822,997.840132 frxUSD balance at Ethereum block 25580115 still rounds to 90.4% frxUSD, 5.9% ETH/LST collateral, 3.6% sUSDe, and 0.1% syrupUSDC. The 2026-08-08 R13 pass added explicit V9 scoring fields (assetClass, issuerOrObligor, riskFactors, liquidityHorizon) to every slice, including the tracked-stablecoin slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current issuer API mint-market DUSD debt combined with the on-chain USM underlying balance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All active DUSD issuance paths and their direct backing assets are identified.
